thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: queue_depth_per_shard > 5000 for svc-inference (sustained 3m). Q latency 95p > 2.8s. autoescalate=true
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident triggered: PD#INC-20421 — High queue backlog on svc-inference. Paging primary oncall: @alex. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-20421
alex: acked — taking it. seeing 5xx spike too?
mira: i see increased enqueue rate from batch jobs, looks like a small-req spike on /v1/embeddings
cheng: confirming new consumer traffic from partner-integration-prod around 10:05UTC, ~3x baseline
alex: checking autoscaler logs and k8s metrics now. my gut: autoscaler not keeping up with burst or hit max_replicas cap
alex: `kubectl get hpa svc-inference -n prod -o yaml` shows targetCPU 60%, replicas 10/10 (max 10)
mira: ah max_replicas=10, that's probably it. can we bump to 30?
cheng: cluster has GPU quota limits in region-a, cannot spin > 12 gpus without quota request. we can failover some shards to region-b pools though
alex: rolling plan: 1) open PD incident, 2) temporarily increase max_replicas (if quota allows) or 3) route lower-priority traffic to fallback model variant, 4) manual surge via reserved pool in region-b.
alex: running quick triage commands:
```
# check hpa
kubectl get hpa svc-inference -n prod
# inspect queue lengths
curl -s http://metrics.internal/prom/api/v1/query?query=queue_depth{service="svc-inference"}
```
mira: if we can't scale GPUs, can we change serving config to reduce per-request GPU memory (quantize) or route heavy batched requests to a separate pool?
cheng: quantization change needs model reload and will take ~5-10m, doable for degraded mode. routing changes are faster if we flip traffic policy in envoy config
alex: i attempted to patch HPA to maxReplicas=20 but patch failed: `403 quota exceeded`
incident-bot: PD escalation timer: 9m until escalate to oncall-secondary
alex: manually opening short-term workaround: enable fallback variant `svc-inference-lite` for non-authenticated /bulk requests. applying routing rule now
mira: note: fallback model has lower quality, need to add banner for affected customers and set rate limit higher for paid customers
cheng: applying envoy route patch:
```
PATCH /v1/config/envoy
{
  "route": "/v1/embeddings",
  "match": {"header":"x-client-tier","value":"free"},
  "backend": "svc-inference-lite"
}
```
alex: route applied. monitoring q depth and 95p latency. initial readouts: queue depth dropping 35% after route flip. 95p latency down from 3.1s to 1.9s for main pool
mira: sending customer notif draft to infra-status channel and support to prep responses — tagging paid customers who might see degraded quality
alex: PD ack still active. I'm going to escalate to @mira for handoff — I've started a scaledown of low-priority batch workers consuming GPU slots
incident-bot: Alex acknowledged the page at 1947654337
pagerduty: Incident INC-20421 escalated to secondary oncall: @mira (auto-escalation)
mira: acked, taking over. going to request emergency quota bump with cloud-ops and start creating region-b nodes for reserve pool
mira: @cheng can you open a quota request in cloud console and ping ops? need +20 GPUs in region-a or enable bursting in region-b
cheng: on it. filed ticket CLOUD-9876, requesting 20 GPU quota increase in region-a and creating a new nodepool in region-b with taints for inference-reserve
cheng: creating nodepool now, will have nodes ready ~8-12m (spot mixed)
mira: in parallel i'll adjust autoscaler policy: change scale-up stabilization to faster and increase maxReplicas to 30 once quota confirmed. prepping patch:
```
kubectl patch hpa svc-inference -n prod -p '{"spec": {"maxReplicas": 30}}'
```
mira: placing a hold on non-essential deploys in prod to avoid noise — set `deploy-freeze=true` for 15m
alex: support updated status page: "We are mitigating increased request backlog; some customers may experience degraded embedding quality while we route traffic to a fallback model. Engineers are actively scaling capacity." :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Incident has been updated: status=mitigating, impact=partial, affected=embeddings API, start=1947654321
ching: (typo) meant cheng ^
cheng: quota request approved by cloud-ops (provisional) — applying HPA patch now
cheng: HPA patch succeeded. new replica targets 30. cluster autoscaler triggered new nodes. watching node join events
mira: nodes joining, pods scheduling. queue depth trending down to normal after surge; 95p latency back to ~650ms for main pool
alex: nice work. can we keep autoscaler max at 30 but set a longer cooldown to avoid flapping?
mira: yes, set stabilization to 60s and add metric-based target for queue_length to HPA (custom metric)
alex: creating follow-up ticket to make queue_length a first-class metric for autoscaler: INFRA-1221
incident-bot: PD INC-20421: no longer paging (progressing). escalation timer cancelled.
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged closed by @mira pending postmortem
mira: handing back to alex for final cleanups and postmortem. I'll stay on the postmortem and customer comms.
alex: thanks, will run a post-incident checklist, gather logs, and schedule a 30m blameless postmortem.
cheng: leaving notes: root cause = burst traffic from partner-integration + conservative maxReplicas and region quota. mitigation = routing fallback + emergency scaling + nodepool in region-b. action items: INFRA-1221 (metric HPA), CLOUD-9877 (perm quota), INFRA-1222 (fallback routing flagging), COMM-334 (customer comms).
mira: thanks team. closing thread once postmortem doc created. :white_check_mark:
